feed.title: Google Cloud: Cloud Profiler
feed.subtitle: Changelog for Google Cloud product: Cloud Profiler

entry.content:
The Cloud Profiler Java agent is updated with a new Certification Authority (CA) certificate bundle, in response to security bulletin GCP-2026-071. Google Cloud infrastructure and the Cloud Profiler backend service are not affected.

If you use the Cloud Profiler Java agent, take one of the following actions:

  • Upgrade the Java agent to cloud-profiler-java-agent_20261026_RC00 (GitHub release v0.5.0) or later, and then rebuild and redeploy your applications. Download the updated archive, https://storage.googleapis.com/cloud-profiler/java/cloud-profiler-java-agent_20261026_RC00.tar.gz, or, for musl-based Alpine Linux containers, https://storage.googleapis.com/cloud-profiler/java/cloud-profiler-java-agent_20261026_RC00_alpine.tar.gz.
  • If you can't immediately upgrade or rebuild, update your host or container operating system's CA certificate store as described in GCP-2026-071, and then set the GRPC_DEFAULT_SSL_ROOTS_FILE_PATH environment variable to point to the updated PEM bundle.

For more information about installing the agent, see Profiling Java applications.
entry.summary: The Cloud Profiler Java agent has been updated with a new security certificate bundle. To maintain security, please upgrade the agent or update your system's CA certificate store as described in the security bulletin.
entry.title: Security: Java agent security update
